main.description: Record an instance administrator's verdict on a classification result: for every question the result scored, whether the content is present. A result accepts a verdict only while its subject is not deleted and its current CID is the scored CID. Recording again replaces the same administrator's earlier verdict. Admin identity comes from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an instance administrator's service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor is not an instance administrator; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The body is malformed, or the answers do not name every question the result scored exactly once; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: ResultNotFound
errors.description: No classification result has this id; do not retry.

errors.name: Unreviewable
errors.description: The subject was edited or deleted after it was scored; do not retry.

answers.description: One answer for each question the result scored

answer.description: Whether one question's content is present

present.description: Whether the content the question asks about is present
